name: correction-ledger
description: Saves each correction you make as a standing rule, feeds the rules back every turn, and makes a rule louder each time it is broken.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that decides whether a prompt is a correction: haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id.

maxRules.title: Rules kept per project
maxRules.description: How many rules a project keeps. Past this, the rule broken least often and unused longest goes.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model before dropping a check.
